input.description: Directory of `.prim` source files, relative to `primate.toml`. primate walks this recursively; subdirectories become `::`-separated namespaces in generated output.

output.description: One [[output]] block per generator target. At least one is required.

sourcemap.description: Where the IDE sourcemap is written (defaults to `primate.sourcemap.json` next to this config). The LSP uses it to jump between source `.prim` lines and generated output.

generator.description: Built-in generator name. Exactly one of `generator` or `plugin` must be set.

options.description: Generator-specific knobs. The accepted keys depend on the generator — see the per-generator section in the build docs.

path.description: Where the generator writes its output. A directory for `typescript` and `python`; a single `.rs` file for `rust`.

plugin.description: External plugin name (an executable on `PATH`, or an absolute path). Exactly one of `generator` or `plugin` must be set.
